reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.body:
Someone asked to reset the password for {app} ({email}).

Choose a new password here:
{link}

The link works once, for {minutes} minutes. If it was not you, ignore this email: your password has not changed.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address

code.subject: Your sign-in code

two_step_on.subject: Two-step verification was turned on
two_step_on.body:
Two-step verification is now on for {email}: {method} was added, from the address {ip}.

Every sign-in to this account now asks for it after the password. If you did not add it, contact your administrator straight away: they can turn it off, and you can then reset your password.
